Malformed/nonfinite/zero-normal observations must fail before writing geometry. Report fields must match the requested schema exactly.

Keep scoped native objects alive through export and never reassign a using variable. Return the whole program, including every helper. Do not substitute a sphere or a lattice primitive for a different requested solid.

Preserve every input, size and void specification. A refusal must also reject an empty/sparse observation. No viewer and no manufacture claim. Use the documented oriented-normal voxelization constructor for point clouds. Refusal output must match the requested JSON fields exactly for nominal, empty and sparse inputs.
